goal: Prevent local RPC cookie credential theft when the IPv4 loopback port is held by another process
Require IPv4 loopback binding to succeed on startup, or fail closed if configured endpoints cannot be bound
agreement: Strong support with substantive review and no open objections
Full approval noting it fixes local credential leakage (janb84)
Concept approval noting bitcoin-cli defaults to IPv4 and needs matching listener (winterrdog)
Open suggestions on failing fast earlier during bind and address lookup (janb84, winterrdog)
Concept approval without stated reasons (l0rinc, sedited)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it fixes a local credential leakage vulnerability during node startup
Stops bitcoind from failing open when IPv4 fails, preventing plaintext cookies going to rogue processes
